status: PROVISIONAL RESEARCH CONTROLS. Not user-approved live-trading limits.
equity_basis: economic (trading equity minus accrued operating expenses)

definitions.pause_entries: No new BUY orders. Existing holdings, pending sells and exits continue. Resuming requires a logged human action.
definitions.cancel_pending: Cancel all OPEN/PARTIALLY_FILLED simulated orders. Holdings are unchanged.
definitions.liquidate: Submit protected SELL orders for every holding. Fills depend on simulated market conditions; gaps, price bands and thin liquidity can mean exits fill below the threshold or not at all on that day.
definitions.halt: Pause entries + cancel pending buys + liquidate, then end the experiment as HALTED. A halted experiment is never resumed; a new experiment must be created.
